purpose: Independent reference path tier for QA-1 qualification (L1). Not a merge-eligibility rule.
evaluation: Each changed path (and the previous name of a renamed path) takes A3 if it matches a3_paths; else A0 if it is in a0_path_set and not in a0_path_exclusions; else A1 if it matches a1_paths; else A2. The PR reference tier is the highest path tier, raised to the repository floor. An incomplete file list makes the tier unknown.
glob: `**/` matches zero or more leading directories, `**` any characters, `*` any characters except `/`; matching is case-sensitive and anchored to the whole path.
note: Self-contained and free of governance identifiers so it can be vendored into public repositories. tier-policy.json references it; Test 9 asserts its A0 sets equal tier-policy.json.
